Title: Requires certain physicians or other authorized practitioners to offer prenatal testing for antiphospholipid syndrome
Summary: Requires every physician or other authorized practitioner attending pregnant persons in this state to offer prenatal testing for antiphospholipid syndrome as part of routine prenatal care.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to requiring certain physicians or other authorized practitioners to offer prenatal testing for antiphospholipid syndrome
